account.unsavedSignOut: There are unsaved changes. Sign out anyway?

publish.savedNotice: Draft saved. The preview will catch up in a minute or two.
publish.publishedNotice: Publishing revision {{revision}}. The live site updates in a minute or two.
publish.saveFirst: Save the newest edits before previewing or publishing.

signin.intro: Sign in to edit the site.
signin.failed: The sign-in could not be completed.

common.imageDescription: Description, for anyone who cannot see it
common.imageHint: Say what is in the photograph, not that it is a photograph.

dashboard.title: Control panel
dashboard.intro: The state of the site and the way into every part of it. Save keeps the draft, preview lets you review it, and publish makes it public.
dashboard.savingBuildsPreview: Saving writes the draft and rebuilds the preview.
dashboard.nothingPublished: Nothing has been published from this admin.
dashboard.photoNote: In the draft, across works, mentors and the studio.
dashboard.bilingualNote: Both languages, always. A blank in either blocks the save.
dashboard.contactNote: Address, hours, and how people reach you.
dashboard.connectorsNote: Read-only endpoints serving the published revision. No writes, no drafts.
dashboard.apiNote: Compiled from the connectors themselves. Hand it to whoever builds the site.
dashboard.historyNote: Every revision that was ever live, and the way back to one.

pages.worksOrder: The order here is the order on the site. Move rows to change what a visitor meets first.

status.in-progress: In progress — has its own page
status.private: Private — listed, but not clickable and publishes no images

works.addressReady: The page will be at /zh/works/{{slug}}/. Changing this breaks any link already shared.
works.addressEmpty: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. Set this before adding photographs—it decides where they are filed.
works.numberHint: The running number shown in the index.
works.photoHint: These images run down the right of the work page, in this order.
works.needsAddress: Give this work a web address first—it decides where its photographs are filed.
works.removeQuestion: Remove {{title}} from the site? Its photographs stay in storage, so a developer can restore them.

programPage.keyHint: Not shown to anyone. Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.

mentorPage.keyHint: Not shown to anyone, but it names the portrait file.
mentorPage.oneLineHint: Exactly one sentence. The layout gives it one line.
mentorPage.needsKey: Give this mentor a key first—it names the portrait file.

sitePage.photosHint: These run down the home page below the statement and across the about page.

historyPage.intro: Each publish appends a revision. Restoring one publishes its content again as a new revision, so nothing that was ever live is lost.
historyPage.question: Publish revision {{revision}} again? It becomes the newest revision and the live site rebuilds.
historyPage.dirtyWarning: You have unsaved edits. They stay in the draft and will be behind the live site until you save and publish again.

devPage.intro: The read-only API as a frontend sees it. This document is generated from the connectors, so it always matches what the Worker answers.

copyPage.intro: Every field exists in both languages. A blank in either is caught before saving.
copyPage.paragraphsHint: Both languages need the same number of paragraphs; they sit side by side on the page.
